name: PayHere
line: Sri Lankan gateway with payment links, checkout and recurring card plans.

free.text: Lite plan has no monthly fee; recurring billing needs Plus or higher

cells.countries: Sri Lankan businesses; foreign seller rules unclear
cells.payout: Daily settlement at T+2 bank days
